author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices finding the hand's place, call and response, short and long notes, and counting beats, with Stephen Foster's racing song.

classes.title: Find your racing hand
classes.goal: Find D between the two black keys and rest the hand on D, E, G and A.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys to find where the hand lives

classes.parentPrompt: Point to the two black keys; help the thumb rest on D, right between them.
classes.childAction: Thumb on D, finger 2 on E, then 4 and 5 on G, A.
classes.bridge: D is the starting gate between the two black keys; the other fingers line up.

intro.caption: Thumb in the starting gate
intro.parentCue: help the thumb rest on D, between the black keys

games.caption: Line up: D, E, G, A

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the hand's place by a landmark.

classes.title: G is the home stable
classes.goal: Play 'Camptown ladies' and notice how the tune keeps coming back to G.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune leaves one note and keeps coming back to it

classes.parentPrompt: Tap finger 4 on your child's hand each time the tune lands on G.
classes.childAction: Play finger 4 on G, hop away, and come back to G.
classes.bridge: G is the stable; the horse trots out to E or A, then home to G.

intro.caption: Out and back to G
intro.parentCue: tap finger 4 each time G comes back

games.caption: Camptown ladies, nice and slow
games.parentCue: Say the finger numbers out loud together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: noticing a note the tune returns to.

classes.title: Doo-dah, short and long
classes.goal: Play 'doo-dah, doo-dah': a short note, then a long one, twice.

mathTarget.parentLine: A quick note, then one that lasts much longer

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'doo' quickly and 'daaah' long while your child plays E, then D.
classes.childAction: Play E quickly, then hold D long: doo-daaah, doo-daaah.
classes.bridge: Doo is a quick hop; dah is a long gallop stretch across the field.

intro.caption: Doo is quick, dah is long

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing short and long notes.

classes.title: You call, I answer
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly as a call and answer between grown-up and child.

mathTarget.parentLine: One part asks, the other part answers

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the Camptown lines; your child answers the doo-dahs. You play the last low C.
classes.childAction: Listen to the call, then answer with your doo-dahs.
classes.bridge: The singer calls across the racetrack; the crowd answers back: doo-dah!

intro.caption: I call, you answer
intro.parentCue: sing the call lines; your child plays the doo-dahs

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: calling and answering, taking turns.

classes.title: Gallop, gal-lop
classes.goal: Play the quick 'Camptown ladies' notes slowly, two quick notes to each beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Quick notes come two for every one beat

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'gal-lop' on each beat while your child plays; go slow, then a little faster.
classes.childAction: Play two quick notes for every gallop beat.
classes.bridge: A beat is one gallop; the quick notes are two hooves, gal-lop.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: fitting two quick notes into one beat.

classes.title: Four beats round the track
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly while counting four beats in every bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar holds four even beats

classes.parentPrompt: Tap your child's shoulder on each beat, count 1, 2, 3, 4. You play the low C.
classes.childAction: Play slowly while your grown-up counts to four.
classes.bridge: Each bar is one lap with four steps: one, two, three, four.

intro.caption: Slow and even wins the race
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder and count to four

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing slowly and evenly in fours.

classes.title: Run with the horses
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping up with a beat that does not wait

classes.parentPrompt: Nod on each beat, sing the calls and play the low C; if a note slips, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music and keep going, even after a slip.
classes.bridge: The horses run all day; hop on and keep racing, even past bumps.

intro.caption: Hop on and keep racing
intro.parentCue: nod the beat and smile at slips

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music together.

classes.title: Race-day concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy with a cheering, bouncy sound, then bow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing the same notes with a cheerful, bouncy feel

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; announce the song, cheer 'doo-dah!' together, then bow.
classes.childAction: Play bouncy and proud for teddy, then take a bow.
classes.bridge: Play like a cheering crowd at the races: bouncy, bright, then a big finish.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song with a bouncy feel.
